_comment: Sealdrop: self-hosted end-to-end encrypted file sharing. Import in Admin → Nests → Import Egg.
name: Sealdrop
author: admin@example.com
description: End-to-end encrypted file hosting with short-lived AI links, expiry, burn-after-reading and local redaction. Needs HTTPS in front (reverse proxy on the node).
startup: if [[ ! -f package.json ]]; then echo "Upload the Sealdrop files first (see README)"; exit 1; fi; if [[ ! -f dist/web/index.html || "{{REBUILD}}" == "1" ]]; then npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build; fi; node server/src/index.ts

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Sealdrop installer. Runs once in a throwaway container; /mnt/server becomes /home/container.
set -e
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq git ca-certificates >/dev/null
cd /mnt/server

if [ -n "${GIT_REPO}" ]; then
  if [ -d .git ]; then
    echo "Updating existing checkout"
    git pull --ff-only
  else
    echo "Cloning ${GIT_REPO}"
    rm -rf /tmp/src
    git clone --depth 1 ${GIT_BRANCH:+--branch "${GIT_BRANCH}"} "${GIT_REPO}" /tmp/src
    cp -a /tmp/src/. /mnt/server/
  fi
fi

if [ -f package.json ]; then
  npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
  npm run build
  echo "Sealdrop built."
else
  echo "No code yet. Upload the Sealdrop files (unzip them into /home/container) and restart: the server builds itself on first start."
fi
mkdir -p data

variables.name: Upload secret
variables.description: Password needed to upload (viewing links never needs it). At least 16 characters; generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

variables.name: Max temporary lifetime (days)
variables.description: Longest expiry a temporary file may have.

variables.name: Max AI link lifetime (hours)
variables.description: Longest lifetime of an AI link.

variables.name: Behind reverse proxy
variables.description: true when a reverse proxy (Caddy/nginx) sits in front, which it should.

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: Optional. HTTPS URL of your Sealdrop repo, cloned at install / reinstall. Leave empty to upload the files yourself.

variables.name: Rebuild on start
variables.description: 1 = reinstall dependencies and rebuild the web app on every start (use after uploading new code). 0 = only when missing.
